## `match_hyphenated_gmbh_ag` 💣

**F1:** 0.018 | **Precision:** 0.949 | **Recall:** 0.009  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `bc5103a0`  
**Description:**
Matches hyphenated company names ending in GMBH or AG, strictly requiring a hyphen in the name part to avoid false positives on generic names like 'Reinhard Stulik Steuerberatungs GmbH'.

**Content:**
```
\b([A-Z][A-Za-zäöüß\-]+(?:-[A-Z][A-Za-zäöüß\-]+)+\s+(?:GmbH|GMBH|AG|A\.G\.)\b)
```

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `a5cc4cae`  
**Description:**
Matches organization names ending in 'KG' where the name includes a title (Mag., Dr.) or a specific multi-word structure, ensuring full capture and excluding partial matches.

**Content:**
```
\b(?:Mag\.?\s+[A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*|Dr\.?\s+[A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*|[A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)+)\s+(?:Stb\.?\s+)?KG\b
```
